description: A company make both liquid and foam hand sanitizer. Liquid hand sanitizer requires 40 units of water and 50 units of alcohol. Foam hand sanitizer requires 60 units of water and 40 units of alcohol. The company has available 2000 units of water and 2100 units of alcohol. The number of foam hand sanitizers made must exceed the number of liquid hand sanitizers. In addition, at most 30 liquid hand sanitizers can be made. If each liquid hand sanitizer can clean 30 hands and each foam hand sanitizer can clean 20 hands, how many of each should the company make to maximize the number of hands that can be cleaned?

ResourceRequired.definition: Amount of each resource required to produce one unit of each product

TotalAvailableResources.definition: Total available units of each resource

MaxLiquidSanitizers.definition: Maximum number of liquid hand sanitizers that can be produced

CleaningPerUnit.definition: Number of hands cleaned by each unit of each product

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of hands that can be cleaned by producing liquid and foam hand sanitizers"

constraints.description: 40 * (Number of liquid sanitizers) + 60 * (Number of foam sanitizers) ≤ 2000 (Total available water)
50 * (Number of liquid sanitizers) + 40 * (Number of foam sanitizers) ≤ 2100 (Total available alcohol)
Number of foam sanitizers produced ≥ Number of liquid sanitizers produced

LiquidSanitizers.definition: Number of liquid hand sanitizers produced

FoamSanitizers.definition: Number of foam hand sanitizers produced
